prompt: vibedgames is agent-driven — read AGENTS.md first. Local stack: `pnpm install && pnpm bootstrap --yes` (creates `.env` from `.env.example`, initializes the local Miniflare D1, pushes the schema and seeds it; idempotent), then `pnpm dev:web`. Seeded browser login: user@vibedgames.com / password123 (admin@vibedgames.com for admin). Gate every change with `pnpm verify`. Never run `cf deploy`, `wrangler deploy` or `pnpm db:push-remote` — those hit production. `pnpm db:push` and `pnpm db:studio` are local-only and safe. `vg deploy` against `http://localhost:5173` is safe: uploads proxy into the local Miniflare R2 bucket. `http://127.0.0.1:5173` is not — that host skips the proxy and writes to production R2.

hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = "true" ] && cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { [ ! -x /opt/node24/bin/node ] || { export PATH="/opt/node24/bin:$PATH"; [ -z "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] || echo 'export PATH="/opt/node24/bin:$PATH"' >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; }; } && pnpm install || true

payload=$(cat); file=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$file" ] || exit 0; root=$(git -C "$(dirname "$file")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; bin="$root/node_modules/.bin/ultracite"; [ -x "$bin" ] || exit 0; cd "$root" && printf '%s' "$payload" | "$bin" fix --hook

sid=$(sed -n 's/.*"session_id" *: *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | cut -c1-8); [ -n "$sid" ] && command -v agent-browser >/dev/null && agent-browser session list 2>/dev/null | sed -n "s/^[^[:alnum:]]*\($sid[^ ]*\) *$/\1/p" | while read -r s; do agent-browser --session "$s" close >/dev/null 2>&1; done; true

in=$(cat); sid=$(printf '%s' "$in" | sed -n 's/.*"session_id" *: *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | cut -c1-8); aid=$(printf '%s' "$in" | sed -n 's/.*"agent_id" *: *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | sed 's/^agent-//' | cut -c1-6); [ -z "$sid" ] || [ -z "$aid" ] || printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SubagentStart","additionalContext":"If you drive a browser, pass --session %s-%s to every agent-browser command, so you get a browser of your own."}}' "$sid" "$aid"; true
